dashboard.radarBody: See which diseases other farmers are reporting near you — anonymised and aggregated.

ndvi.title: Satellite crop health (NDVI)
ndvi.failed: Satellite data is unavailable right now.
ndvi.notConfigured: Satellite crop health isn't configured on this server.
ndvi.noBoundary: Draw this field's boundary on the map to get satellite crop health.
ndvi.noData: No cloud-free Sentinel-2 pass in the last 90 days.
ndvi.declining: Vegetation is declining — scout this field for stress before symptoms show.
ndvi.mapAlt: NDVI heatmap of the field (red = stressed, green = healthy)

yield.title: Yield estimate
yield.unknownCrop: Yield estimates are available for wheat, rice, maize, cotton, tomato, potato, soybean and sugarcane.
yield.disclaimer: Estimate only — based on typical yields, not a field measurement

sensors.title: Field sensors
sensors.waiting: Sensor connected — waiting for the first reading.
sensors.none: Connect a soil sensor (e.g. ESP32) to see live moisture, temperature and humidity.
sensors.tokenOnce: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again.
sensors.confirmRevoke: Disconnect the sensor? It will stop being able to send readings.

market.notConfigured: Mandi prices aren't configured on this server (DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY).
market.perQuintal: Modal price per quintal · {markets, plural, one {# market} other {# markets}}
market.forecastNote: Dashed line: linear-trend forecast, not financial advice.
market.buildingHistory: Trend builds up as daily prices are collected.

radar.title: Outbreak radar
radar.subtitle: Anonymised crop disease reports from farmers near you.
radar.needLocation: Set a location on your active farm or use your current location.
radar.empty: No outbreaks reported by enough farmers in this area.
radar.privacy: Only areas where at least {k} different farms reported the same problem are shown, and locations are rounded to ~11 km cells.

scan.title: Scan a plant
scan.subtitle: Point your camera at a leaf for an instant check, then ask AgriLens for a full diagnosis.
scan.denied: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or attach a photo in chat.
scan.unsupported: This browser can't open the camera. Attach a photo in chat instead.
scan.failed: Couldn't analyse the photo. Check your connection.
scan.noModel: Live on-device detection isn't configured — capture a photo and AgriLens will analyse it online.
scan.tip: Fill the frame with the affected leaves in good daylight, then tap the shutter.

onDevice.label: On-device guess
onDevice.refine: AgriLens will confirm when you send

cases.title: Expert cases
cases.subtitle: AI answers you've sent to an agronomist for review.
cases.empty: No cases yet. Use “Ask an expert” under any AI answer in chat.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp assistant
whatsapp.hint: Message the AgriLens WhatsApp number with questions or crop photos. Answers use your credits.
whatsapp.taken: This number is already linked to another account.
whatsapp.failed: Couldn't save the number. Include the country code.
